fact1_source: gae/bootstrap.py:252-308 bootstrap_enriched_prior(). The 250 shadow decisions are used ONLY in compute_enriched_bootstrap_prior() to compute mu0_enriched (the initial centroid prior). They are not pushed into a live learning buffer. The function explicitly documents: 'standalone, no live scorer' (line 267) and 'Loop 2 firewall is maintained: sigma enters the prior computation at initialization time only, not during live learning' (gae/calibration.py:554). The live ProfileScorer is initialized with mu0_enriched but starts its own learning buffer empty.
fact2_formula: N_half = ln(2) / ln(1/(1-eta)). At eta=0.05: N_half = ln(2)/ln(1/0.95) = 13.51 decisions. This IS the N where centroid error reaches 50% of initial error (definition of half-life). Source: gae/convergence.py:39 N_HALF_DEFAULT=13.51 and :49-68 compute_n_half(). The convergence model is exponential decay: e(N) = (1-eta)^N * e(0); within 50% means (1-eta)^N <= 0.5, i.e., N >= N_half = 13.51 ≈ 14 decisions per cell. Note: task spec states N_half/ln(2) ≈ 20; code gives N_half ≈ 14 directly as the 50%-asymptote threshold.
fact3_reasoning: P28-seeded mu0 IS the IKS anchor (bootstrap_enriched_prior() writes mu0_enriched to iks_bootstrap_soc.json via write_iks_bootstrap_anchor — gae/bootstrap.py:44-58). IKS = 100 * min(D(t)/D_MAX, 1.0) measures drift from this anchor. If mu0 starts 22% closer to mu*, the natural learning drift from anchor to steady-state is ~22% shorter (D_natural ≈ 0.78 * D_standard). With D_MAX=0.20 calibrated for a non-enriched expert prior: (a) if D_MAX is kept at 0.20, IKS will never reach 100 after enriched bootstrap (it saturates at ~78% when learning completes); (b) D_MAX must be rescaled to ~0.156 (= 0.20 * 0.78) to maintain the same saturation semantics. Recalibration is required BECAUSE the P28-seeded mu0 replaces the IKS anchor, not merely the expert prior.
